about_the_game:
🩸 Alter Psycho

Are you the spawn of the devil, or just a child?

In a quiet and fog-covered village, a child shunned by society struggles to survive. Growing up without a father, labeled as the "devil's son," this innocent soul takes each step surrounded by fear and paranoia. His story will take you on a deep psychological journey. In a world where no one but his mother shows him love, one night changes everything. Now, he must run.

Through misty forests, terrifying hallucinations, and ominous villagers, the fight isn't just for survival—it's to reclaim his lost childhood.

🎮 What Awaits You in the Game

  • Psychological thriller atmosphere

  • Interactive and story-driven missions

  • Scenes shifting between reality and delusion

  • Stealth and survival mechanics

  • A rich narrative and cinematic experience

"Alter Psycho" offers an unforgettable narrative shaped by darkness.
Want to escape? First, you must find out who you really are.

short_description: No one ever listened to you. Because they never truly knew you. Now the forest whispers, the fire rises, and they all watch you. Could you be innocent, or are you merely a well-hidden disaster?
